h:
我是因为 GitHub 上的一位用户向我提出要求而匆匆忙忙地完成了它，所以不要太挑剔。

核心模型为灵活的照片重建，同时保留您的身份是字节跳动公司的，您可以在他们的 GitHub 页面上阅读所有相关内容和许可条款。

ComfyUI的节点是ZenAI团队的，请关注他们所有的下载和安装说明我刚刚替换了 GGUF 版本的模型和 TE 节点，添加了 LoRA 节点和保存图像节点（v. 4.0 - 添加了 SIMILARITY 和 FLEXIBILITY 模型之间的切换，v. 5.0 - Lora 节点替换为多个 Lora 节点）并进行了其他细微调整。

此工作流程中用于下载的 GGUF 模型：

GGUF FLUX.1 开发 Q8 , GGUF T5 XXL FLAN 转换文本编码器 Q8

该工作流程在 16Gb RTX 4080 Super 上进行了测试，中速为每 1024x1024 图像生成 2 分钟。

我非常感谢字节跳动公司y禅智团队感谢他们的支持和出色的工作，当我有更多时间时，我会相应地调整此页面。

您可以将此工作流程与建议资源中列出的我的任何 LoRA 结合使用

这个工作流程是完全免费的，但是如果您想以任何理由支持我并激励我继续我的工作，您可以请我喝杯咖啡https://ko-fi.com/cocosus

如果您在 python 级别上遇到任何错误，解决该问题的最佳方法是阅读开发人员页面上的问题历史记录（上面的链接），如果它仍然存在，则会打开一个新问题。在出现“facexlib”或“filterpy”错误的特定情况下，请阅读此内容问题还有这个问题如何解决它或写信给我，我很乐意帮助我了解这个节点和模型的经验，但我不是这个节点/模型的开发人员，在这种情况下只是一个工作流程优化器。

您可以在我的网站上找到一些我独有的 LoRA张量艺术帐户https://tensor.art/u/857428067369388114，比如“沙画” LoRA 为例：https://tensor.art/models/866823207397679395/Sand-Drawing-V1-BEST

o.en:
I have made it on big hurry and sleepy just because I've being asked for it by one user on GitHub, so don't be too picky.

Core model forFlexible Photo Recrafting While Preserving Your Identityis of Bytedance Inc., you can read on their GitHub page all related and the License terms.

The Node for ComfyUI is of ZenAI Team, please, followall their instructions for downloading and installingi just replaced the model and TE nodes for GGUF versions, added LoRA node and Save image node (v. 4.0 - added Switch between SIMILARITY and FLEXIBILITY models, v. 5.0 - Lora node replaced for Multiple Lora node) and made other minor adjustments.

GGUF models used in this Workflow for downloading:

GGUF FLUX.1 Dev Q8 , GGUF T5 XXL FLAN Converted Text Encoder Q8

The workflow was tested on 16Gb RTX 4080 Super with the medium speed of 2 minutes per 1024x1024 image generation.

I am very thankful toBytedance IncyZenAI Teamfor their support and their great work, when I have a bit more time I will adjust this page accordingly.

You can use this workflow with any of my LoRAs listed in Suggested Resources

This workflow is completely free of charge, but if you want to support me for any reason and motivate me to continue my work you can buy me a coffeehttps://ko-fi.com/cocosus

If you get any error on python level the best way to solve it is reading history of issues on developers pages (links above) and if it persists opening a new issue. In a specific case of getting "facexlib" or "filterpy" error read please thisissueand thisissuehow to solve it or write me, i will be glad to help in what is my own experience with this node and model, but i am not a developer of this node/model, just a workflow optimizer in this case.

You can find some of my exclusive LoRAs on myTensor.artaccounthttps://tensor.art/u/857428067369388114, like “Sand Drawing” LoRA, for example:https://tensor.art/models/866823207397679395/Sand-Drawing-V1-BEST
